newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: S.African AstraSat to announce partners next month.
newsitem.headline: S.African AstraSat to announce partners next month.

text.p: AstraSat, the satellite television arm of South Africa's public broadcaster SABC, will announce its equity partners next month, chief executive Gert Claassen said.
"We are getting on with the discussions very well, but we will announce it when we are ready, which should be some time next month," he told Reuters on Wednesday.
The South African Broadcasting Corporation is to retain a 40 percent slice of AstraSat, but offer international investors 20 percent and local players 40 percent.
The planned six channel service is set to launch early next year.

Claassen said the number of partners depended solely on the amount each was prepared to invest. "It could be two, three, four or more depending on how many people are willing to invest how much," he said.
The service has a target of 125,000 subscribers a year after launch, rising to 600,000 in five years.
